MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, or Sector Strength; Technology is sharply negative while the top five performers are concentrated in two sectors, so leadership is Narrow (3/5 Consumer Discretionary and Materials). Broad sector participation and concentrated stock leadership are mixed confirmations; the supplied risk and cycle signals are N/A.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads: GM (1W: +17.86% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND and RCL (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +15.60%) ABOVE TREND. Materials is strong, with PPG (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples follows, with WMT (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +22.47%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest: GOOGL (1W: -11.93% | 1M: -18.78%) and AMD (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -26.36%) are BELOW TREND. Energy is also weak on the week despite a positive month; VLO (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -6.11%) is BELOW TREND, while Communication has modest monthly momentum at +0.32%.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top five: GM (1W: +17.86% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +15.60%) ABOVE TREND, PPG (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +13.07% | 1M: +5.72%) ABOVE TREND, and CRH (1W: +13.06% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Consumer Discretionary and Materials).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom five: INTC (1W: -33.71% | 1M: -49.74%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -32.98% | 1M: -21.11%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -26.36%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -11.93% | 1M: -18.78%) BELOW TREND, and CAT (1W: -11.34% | 1M: -27.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with additional pressure in Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: GM (1W: +17.86% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +15.60%) ABOVE TREND, PPG (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +13.07% | 1M: +5.72%) ABOVE TREND, and CRH (1W: +13.06% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND. TMUS (1W: +9.00% | 1M: -2.13%) is in RECOVERY, a short-term bounce rather than a confirmed trend reversal.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak, with a sector return of -7.17% for the week and -8.97% for the month; stock-level breadth counts were not provided. NVDA (1W: -6.45% | 1M: -13.63%), META (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -16.67%), and GOOGL (1W: -11.93% | 1M: -18.78%) are all BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials show positive sector returns, +2.36% for the week and +5.78% for the month; stock-level breadth counts were not provided. JPM (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +2.98%), V (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +17.98%), and MA (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +19.35%) are ABOVE TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is firm at +2.23% for the week and +10.39% for the month; stock-level breadth counts were not provided. LLY (1W: +10.31% | 1M: +23.46%) and JNJ (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +5.68%) are ABOVE TREND, while UNH (1W: -2.50% | 1M: +7.67%) is in CORRECTION.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Positioning?
Keep positioning selective: sector breadth is strong, but leadership is narrow and Technology is weak. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; monitor cyclical strength in GM (1W: +17.86% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND against continued weakness in NVDA (1W: -6.45% | 1M: -13.63%) BELOW TREND.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Watch CRH (1W: +13.06% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +10.31% | 1M: +23.46%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through; sustained gains would confirm strength. BEARISH: Monitor INTC (1W: -33.71% | 1M: -49.74%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -11.93% | 1M: -18.78%) BELOW TREND for continued downside pressure.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (+5.21% weekly, +10.24% monthly) and Materials (+4.72% weekly, +10.02% monthly) have momentum, though top-stock leadership is narrow. BEARISH: Technology (-7.17% weekly, -8.97% monthly) remains weakest; Energy fell 4.24% for the week despite a 6.06% monthly gain.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied. Watch whether NVDA (1W: -6.45% | 1M: -13.63%) BELOW TREND stabilizes, whether GOOGL (1W: -11.93% | 1M: -18.78%) BELOW TREND extends its decline, and whether JPM (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +2.98%) ABOVE TREND sustains its positive momentum.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
CRH (+75): earnings-call highlights cite resilient revenue growth and a $6 billion buyback; price is ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.06% | 1M: +17.88%), confirming the positive news. LLY (+45): weight-loss drug demand supports the outlook; price is ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.31% | 1M: +23.46%), confirming strength; PLTR (+80) beat estimates and raised guidance, but price is BELOW TREND (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -5.52%), a notable divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CAT (-50): analyst flagged a premium valuation and cut the price target; price is BELOW TREND (1W: -11.34% | 1M: -27.25%), confirming weakness. INTC (-40): the outlook spooked chip investors; price is BELOW TREND (1W: -33.71% | 1M: -49.74%), also confirming weakness.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with style mixed and no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership: breadth is 9/11 sectors positive, but top-five leadership is narrow. Relative strength remains in GM (1W: +17.86% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +10.31% | 1M: +23.46%) ABOVE TREND. Monitor the divergence in PLTR (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -5.52%) BELOW TREND despite strongly positive news, alongside continued Technology weakness.
